words.definition: careful, responsible, and serious about doing work well
words.example: She is a conscientious representative of the student body.
words.zh: 細心、負責、認真做好工作

words.definition: to make something known to others; to communicate
words.example: The manager of the store conveyed his displeasure directly to the workers.
Her plan of study encompasses every aspect of computer science.
Expansion occurs when matter is heated.
A very successful interview can heighten a candidate's chances to get a job.

words.definition: to emphasize the part of a greater whole
words.example: The owner's manual highlights the basic functions of the camera.
words.zh: 強調更大整體的一部分

words.definition: by accident; without paying attention; unexpectedly
words.example: The reporters had inadvertently failed to include the name of one of the dignitaries.

words.definition: something that cannot be prevented from happening
words.example: When two weather systems meet, unpredictable weather conditions are inevitable.

words.definition: in the beginning stages of development
words.example: The technology is still in its infancy, so researchers expect many improvements.
The comedian mimicked the president's gestures.
The club's paramount goal is to raise awareness of the importance of community service.

words.definition: to be skilled or experienced in something
words.example: After years of practice, Elena became proficient in reading scientific articles in English.
words.zh: 在某事上熟練或有經驗

words.example: Will Detroit retrieve its status as the car manufacturing center of the world?
The plan was developed systematically by a team of experts.
With clear skies and low humidity, rain is unlikely during the field trip.

words.definition: without good reason or cause; inappropriate
words.example: The evidence was weak, so the scientist said the alarming conclusion was unwarranted.
words.zh: 沒有充分的理由或理由；不當

words.example: He reached the zenith of his profession at a very young age.
